parameters.name: Number of Threads
parameters.description: Number of threads to use for parallel processing.

parameters.name: Transfer Learning Step (Experimental)
parameters.description: Whether to perform a 'transfer learning' step before the first search. All parameters set here will also be used for this step (except those required to switch on the specific behaviour of this step).

parameters.name: MBR Search Step (Experimental)
parameters.description: Whether to perform a 'second search' step after the first search. All parameters set here will also be used for this step (except those required to switch on the specific behaviour of this step).

parameters.name: Adaptation Method
parameters.description: Method for the adaptation step: 'transfer' (peptdeep transfer learning), 'tto' (peptdeep_kontext test-time optimization) or 'hybrid' (peptdeep_kontext test-time optimization followed by peptdeep_kontext transfer learning). Selected via the Adaptation node in the workflow overview.

parameters_advanced.name: Reuse Ion Quantities
parameters_advanced.description: AlphaDIA will save the quantification results in the project file. If this option is enabled, the quantitative features will be reused for subsequent searches of the same file.

parameters_advanced.name: Reuse Calibration
parameters_advanced.description: Reuse previously calculated calibration data for subsequent searches of the same file.

parameters_advanced.name: Use GPU
parameters_advanced.description: AlphaDIA will use the GPU for some processing steps like library prediction and scoring.

parameters_advanced.name: Log Level
parameters_advanced.description: Log level for the console output.

parameters.name: Extraction Backend
parameters.description: Method to use for search. 'python' uses the original python implementation, 'rust' uses an improved extraction method with better performance and speed (currently available for non-Bruker data only).

parameters.name: MS1 Tolerance
parameters.description: MS1 tolerance in ppm. Search windows are optimized and calibrated during processing. The window is reduced until this tolerance is reached.

parameters.name: MS2 Tolerance
parameters.description: MS2 tolerance in ppm. Search windows are optimized and calibrated during processing. The window is reduced until this tolerance is reached.

parameters.name: Mobility Tolerance
parameters.description: Mobility tolerance in 1/K_0. Search windows are optimized and calibrated during processing. The window is reduced until this tolerance is reached. Set to enable automatic optimization.

parameters.name: RT Tolerance
parameters.description: Retention time tolerance in seconds if greater than 1 or as a proportion of the gradient length if less than 1. Search windows are optimized and calibrated during processing. The window is reduced until this tolerance is reached. Automatic optimization is enabled if set to 0.

parameters_advanced.name: Channel Filter
parameters_advanced.description: Comma separated list eg. 1,2,3. Only precursors with matching channels will be loaded. Leave empty to load all available channels.

parameters_advanced.name: Exclude Shared Ions
parameters_advanced.description: When searching a multiplexed sample some fragment ions are not specific for a single channel. If this option is enabled, these ions will be excluded from the search.

parameters_advanced.name: Compete for Fragments
parameters_advanced.description: If enabled, precursors will compete for fragment ions.

parameters_advanced.name: Number of Candidates
parameters_advanced.description: For every precursor in the library a number of top scoring candidates will be extracted. This number is the maximum number of candidates that will be extracted per precursor.

parameters_advanced.name: Quant window
parameters_advanced.description: Number of datapoints next to the apex that are used for quantification. E.g. 3 means 3 datapoints on each side of the apex are used for quantification.

parameters_advanced.name: Use all MS2 observations
parameters_advanced.description: Use all MS2 observations for quantification. If disabled only the best scoring observation is used for quantification. Recommended for synchro-PASEF data.

parameters.name: Enable Prediction
parameters.description:
Use alphaPeptDeep to predict peptide. 
 If a FASTA file is provided an in silico digest will be performed. 
 If a spectral library is provided precursor properties for library precursor will be performed.

parameters.name: Prediction Framework
parameters.description:
Framework used for library prediction. 
 'peptdeep' uses alphaPeptDeep. 
 'peptdeep_kontext' uses the peptdeep_kontext models (see the Kontext Model Path and Context Path in the advanced parameters). 
 Note: in a multistep search this sets the framework of the adaptation step; the main search uses the framework of the selected adaptation method.

parameters.name: Enzyme
parameters.description: Enzyme used for in-silico digest.

parameters.name: Fixed modifications
parameters.description:
Fixed modifications for in-silico digest. Semicolon separated list 
 Format: Modification@AminoAcid 
 Example: Carbamidomethyl@C;Dimethyl@N-term

parameters.name: Variable modifications
parameters.description:
Variable modifications for in-silico digest. At the moment localisation is not supported. Semicolon separated list 
 Example: Oxidation@M;Acetyl@ProteinN-term

parameters.name: Maximum variable modifications
parameters.description:
Variable modifications for in-silico digest. At the moment localisation is not supported. Semicolon separated list 
 Example: Oxidation@M;Acetyl@ProteinN-term

parameters.name: Missed cleavages
parameters.description: Number of missed cleavages for in-silico digest.

parameters.name: Precursor length
parameters.description: Number of amino acids of generated precursors.

parameters.name: Precursor charge
parameters.description: Charge states of generated precursors.

parameters.name: Precursor mz
parameters.description: Size limit for generated precursors.

parameters.name: Fragment mz
parameters.description: Size limit for generated fragments.

parameters_advanced.name: Normalized collision energy
parameters_advanced.description: Normalized collision energy for fragment generation.

parameters_advanced.name: Fragment types
parameters_advanced.description: List of fragment types to quantify in the library. The PeptDeep model must support the chosen fragment types.

parameters_advanced.name: Maximum fragment charge
parameters_advanced.description: Fragments will be generated up to this charge state. Must be supported by the chosen PeptDeep model.

parameters_advanced.name: Instrument
parameters_advanced.description: Instrument used for ms2 spectrum prediction.

parameters_advanced.name: PeptDeep Model Path
parameters_advanced.description: Custom PeptDeep model for library prediction. Relevant when using 'peptdeep' as the Prediction Framework, or when running the Transfer Learning adaptation method. This can be a DDA or DIA trained model; make sure to use the same instrument type and NCE for prediction as the model was trained on. If empty, a generic model provided by peptdeep is used.

parameters_advanced.name: PeptDeep Model Type
parameters_advanced.description: Pretrained PeptDeep model type for library prediction. Relevant when using 'peptdeep' as the Prediction Framework, or when running the Transfer Learning adaptation method. Possible values are 'generic', 'phospho' and 'digly'.

parameters_advanced.name: Peptdeep_Kontext Model Path
parameters_advanced.description: peptdeep_kontext ContextDownstream model directory used for prediction. If empty, the pretrained model from the PeptDeep Kontext section is used. In a multistep 'hybrid' run this is set automatically for the main search.

parameters_advanced.name: Peptdeep_Kontext Experiment Context Path
parameters_advanced.description: Path to a peptdeep_kontext context.json used for prediction. If empty, the zero context is used. In a multistep 'tto' or 'hybrid' run this is set automatically for the main search.

parameters.name: FDR
parameters.description: Maximum false discovery rate for PSMs.

parameters.name: Inference Level
parameters.description: Inference level for FDR correction.

parameters.name: Inference Strategy
parameters.description:
Inference strategy for protein groups. 
 library: Protein groups are used as reported in the library. 
 maximum_parsimony: Protein groups are inferred using the maximum parsimony principle. 
 heursitic: Protein groups are inferred using maximum parsimony with grouping.

parameters_advanced.name: Channel wise FDR
parameters_advanced.description: In the initial pass before propagating identifications the FDR is calculated for each channel separately. This can be usefull if the composition of the channels differs drastically.

parameters_advanced.name: Keep Decoys
parameters_advanced.description: If enabled, decoy PSMs will be retained in the output.

parameters_advanced.name: Decoy Type
parameters_advanced.description:
Scheme used to generate decoys for the search library and the MBR library. Ignored if the library already contains decoys. 
 diann: mutates the second and second-to-last amino acid (DIA-NN style). 
 pseudo_reverse: reverses the sequence while keeping the C-terminal amino acid.

parameters_advanced.name: Hyperparameter Tuning (Experimental)
parameters_advanced.description: If enabled, the hyperparameters of the neural network like the batch size and learning rate will be tuned.

parameters_advanced.name: MS1 Tolerance
parameters_advanced.description: Initial MS1 tolerance in ppm.

parameters_advanced.name: MS2 Tolerance
parameters_advanced.description: Initial MS2 tolerance in ppm.

parameters_advanced.name: Mobility Tolerance
parameters_advanced.description: Initial mobility tolerance in 1/K_0.

parameters_advanced.name: RT Tolerance
parameters_advanced.description: Initial retention time tolerance in seconds if greater than 1 or as a proportion of the gradient length if less than 1.

parameters_advanced.name: Enable Multiplexing
parameters_advanced.description: Quantify and score identification across non-isobaric labled channels.

parameters_advanced.name: Target Channels
parameters_advanced.description: Target channels contain regular samples and are used for quantification.

parameters_advanced.name: Decoy Channel
parameters_advanced.description: Non-existant channel used for decoy identifications.

parameters_advanced.name: Reference Channel
parameters_advanced.description: The reference channel is only used for guiding identification and is not used for quantification. Some features will be calculated with respect to the reference channel.

parameters_advanced.name: Competetive Scoring
parameters_advanced.description: If enabled, only the best scoring candidate per target decoy pair is retained.

parameters.name: File Format
parameters.description: Output file format. Can be either 'parquet' or 'tsv'.

parameters_advanced.name: Minimum number of fragments
parameters_advanced.description: Minimum number of fragments required for quantification.

parameters_advanced.name: Minimum correlation
parameters_advanced.description: Minimum correlation required for quantification.

parameters_advanced.name: Number of samples for quadratic fit
parameters_advanced.description: Number of samples used for quadratic fit.

parameters_advanced.name: Minimum number of non-nan defaults
parameters_advanced.description: Minimum number of non-nan defaults required for quantification.

parameters_advanced.name: LFQ method
parameters_advanced.description: Select the label-free quantification method. 'directlfq' uses the directLFQ algorithm, 'quantselect' uses the QuantSelect algorithm, 'none' skips label-free quantification.

parameters_advanced.name: Normalize directLFQ
parameters_advanced.description: Apply directLFQ normalization when using the directLFQ method. Only applies when 'directlfq' is selected as the LFQ method.

parameters.name: Enabled for all steps
parameters.description: If true, transfer learning training dataset is created. The settings in this section will be used for all steps. if you are using a multistep workflow, this option will automatically enabled for the transfer learning step. Only use this section to configure individual settings but do not activate this option for all steps.

parameters_advanced.name: Fragment types
parameters_advanced.description: List of fragment types to quantify in the library.

parameters_advanced.name: Maximum charge
parameters_advanced.description: Maximum charge for fragments.

parameters_advanced.name: Top k samples
parameters_advanced.description: If a given precursor appears multiple times in an experiment, only the top_k_samples with the highest scores are included in the library.

parameters_advanced.name: Norm delta max
parameters_advanced.description:
Perform advanced rt calibration. 
If set to false retention times will be normalised by the maximum retention time observed in the experiment. 
If set to true, a combination of maximum normalisation and deviation from the calibration curve will be used.

parameters_advanced.name: Precursor correlation cutoff
parameters_advanced.description: Use only precursors for ms2 training with a median XIC correlation above this threshold.

parameters_advanced.name: Fragment correlation ratio
parameters_advanced.description: Include only fragments with a XIC correlation at least 0.75 of the median for all fragments.

parameters.name: Enabled for all steps
parameters.description: If true, a custom peptdeep model will be created using the transfer learned library. The settings in this section will be used for all steps. if you are using a multistep workflow, this option will automaticallly enabled for the transfer learning step. Only use this section to configure individual settings but do not activate this option for all steps.

parameters_advanced.name: Batch size
parameters_advanced.description: Number of precursors per batch.

parameters_advanced.name: Maximum learning rate
parameters_advanced.description:
Maximum learning rate per batch. 
The maximum learning rate will be reached after a warmup phase and decreased using a plateau scheduler.

parameters_advanced.name: Train fraction
parameters_advanced.description: Fraction of the dataset used for training.

parameters_advanced.name: Validation fraction
parameters_advanced.description: Fraction of the dataset used for validation.

parameters_advanced.name: Test fraction
parameters_advanced.description: Fraction of the dataset used for testing.

parameters_advanced.name: Test interval
parameters_advanced.description: Test every n intervals.

parameters_advanced.name: Learning rate patience
parameters_advanced.description: Learning rate patience after which the lr will be halved.

parameters_advanced.name: Number of epochs
parameters_advanced.description: Maximum number of epochs.

parameters_advanced.name: Warmup epochs
parameters_advanced.description: Number of warmup epochs during which the lr is ramped up.

parameters_advanced.name: Normalized collision energy
parameters_advanced.description: Normalised collision energy encoded during training.

parameters_advanced.name: Instrument
parameters_advanced.description:
Instrument type encoded during training. 
The same instrument type must be used for prediction using the trained model.

parameters.name: Model Directory
parameters.description: Directory containing the pretrained peptdeep_kontext ContextModel/ and ContextDownstream/ models. If empty, the weights are downloaded to ~/.cache/peptdeep_kontext.

parameters.name: Config File
parameters.description: Optional peptdeep_kontext pipeline config (.py or .yaml) to set any other peptdeep_kontext setting. Its tto_config, downstream_finetune_config and model_manager_config sections take precedence over the settings here. Paths, fragment types, context grouping, pretrained models and the device are always set by alphaDIA.

parameters_advanced.name: Model Version
parameters_advanced.description: Version of the pretrained weights to download if no model directory is set.

parameters_advanced.name: TTO Epochs
parameters_advanced.description: Number of passes over the transfer library during test-time optimization.

parameters_advanced.name: TTO Minimum Steps
parameters_advanced.description: Minimum number of optimizer steps during test-time optimization. More epochs are run if needed so that small libraries converge.

parameters_advanced.name: TTO Batch Size
parameters_advanced.description: Number of precursors per batch during test-time optimization.

parameters_advanced.name: TTO Learning Rate
parameters_advanced.description: Learning rate for the context during test-time optimization.

parameters_advanced.name: Transfer Learning Epochs
parameters_advanced.description: Number of passes over the transfer library during transfer learning ('hybrid' adaptation method only).

parameters_advanced.name: Transfer Learning Batch Size
parameters_advanced.description: Number of precursors per batch during transfer learning ('hybrid' adaptation method only).

parameters_advanced.name: Transfer Learning Learning Rate
parameters_advanced.description: Learning rate for the model weights during transfer learning ('hybrid' adaptation method only).

parameters_advanced.name: Transfer Learning Trainable Weights
parameters_advanced.description: Which model weights are trained: 'heads' (output heads only) or 'full' ('hybrid' adaptation method only).

parameters_advanced.name: Transfer Learning Validation Fraction
parameters_advanced.description: Fraction of precursors held out for validation during transfer learning ('hybrid' adaptation method only).

parameters_advanced.name: Transfer Learning Keep Best Epoch
parameters_advanced.description: Keep the epoch with the lowest validation loss. If training never improves, the pretrained weights are kept ('hybrid' adaptation method only).

parameters_advanced.name: Prediction Batch Size
parameters_advanced.description: Number of precursors per batch during prediction.
